rows.en: What is that?
Phew… Yet another weirdo has shown up to ruin our time together, [HERO2].
Out of the way! Out of the way! You're in the way, in the waaay! Obstructing a train is a serious crime!
That guy… how far is he planning to run?
What an unbelievable guy… He's been running around for two hours now!
With steam trains all gone, maybe he's just showin' off to everybody, ain't he?
No way, Daita… Whatever else, we're dealing with the Black Cross Army here.
He's not carrying anything, he's not destroying anything… He's just running and running.
Hmm… I don't get it. I haven't the faintest idea. All right, let's look into it!
Okay!
Let's give it our best.

Almost there… 3 more kilometers and I'll have run through every district.

Okay, here I go! Out of the way, out of the waaay! Chugga-chugga choo-choo, chugga-chugga choo-choo… chugga-chugga choo-choo!
Wh-what!? Look at that speed!?
Whoa, he's so fast…
"Chase Locomotive Mask" "Leave him alone"
After him! [HERO4]!!
He doesn't seem to be out to hurt anyone. If he's just running around, that's not a crime, right?

Yes… that's true. Oh?

An emergency message from the TDF!

An emergency message?

Sigh… You don't have to say it. It's something about that guy, isn't it?

…So it seems!

The order is: "Cooperate with the international defense organization EAGLE, and pursue and capture Locomotive Mask as soon as he is found"…
Locomotive Mask… Well, that has to be him, no matter how you look at it.
Anyway, let's catch him! Let's go, [HERO4]!
Let's go! [HERO4]!!
Huh? You're really gung-ho today, aren't you?
…Is that a problem?

There are people like that, huh? They see a movie and get all into playing the hero… Ufufu… you're surprisingly simple, [HERO2]!

Oh, never mind! Come on, let's go! You look like a real hero. It suits you.
He doesn't seem to be out to hurt anyone. If he's just running around, it's not a crime…
What's wrong!? [HERO4]?
Five… Five powers are chasing that monster from before… We have to go, [HERO2]!
…You can sense them? H-hey, wait a second!
Hm? Those two… are they planning to chase Locomotive Mask!?
That's dangerous. Should we call out and stop them?
No, wait… They don't look like amateurs. Let's watch for a while.
Who's that sneaking along behind meee!?
Tch… He spotted us!?
Damn… He spotted us!

Hm! You lot!?

Wait… I'm sure you're on this blacklist…

Oh, here you are! This is it! Let's see… Danger level B and C… no fixed base, huh…

I see… you've got nothing to do with my current mission.

…Mission?

What kind of mission could you have, just running around?
A mission? Like winning a marathon?

That is a Black Cross Army secret! I can't tell you!!

But fine… you're going to die anyway. I'll tell you, as a souvenir to take to the afterlife!

I'm using the underground detector on my feet to search for the Gorengers' secret base!

3 more kilometers and I'll have run through every district. And then…
Then you'll be able to pinpoint where that secret base is…
These guys will deal with you! And even if you do get away… by then, I'll be at the last stop!
Hear that, Shinmei? All right, let's head him off!!
Okay! Variblune, auto-controllerrr!
Here we gooo! Chugga-chugga choo-choo, chugga-chugga choo-choo… chugga-chugga choo-choo!
Hold it, hold iiit!
We're over here too!
Y-you lot!?

…We heard all about the Black Cross Army's scheme to find the Gorenger secret base!

Locomotive Mask! The rails laid down for you end right here!

Go!!
Akarenger!
Aorenger!
Kirenger!
Momorenger!
Midorenger!
The five of us together…
Gorenger!
So that's Gorenger? The proud elite five of the international defense organization EAGLE…
So that's Gorenger? The proud elite five of the international defense organization EAGLE…
So that's Gorenger!? The proud elite five of the international defense organization EAGLE…
So that's Gorenger!? The proud elite five of the international defense organization EAGLE…

Curse you, Gorenger!

In that case, I'll just have to finish you off right here! Let's go, SL Express!
Kuh… My era is over!
What kinda bulb is trouble if ye light it, eh?
That's easy. A flower bulb.
…A flower bulb, I see!

…I'm Tsuyoshi Kaijo. Leader of Gorenger, Akarenger.

Thanks to you, our secret base's location stayed hidden. Thank you. I'm grateful.
Akira Shinmei, otherwise known as Aorenger. Nice to meet you.
Me, I'm Daita Oiwa. Kirenger, y'see. When it comes to curry, I can eat as many bowls as ye like!
I wonder who can eat more, him or [HERO4] with her desserts? That'd be a sight to see…
H-hey, [HERO2]!
Then it's a contest! But I won't be goin' easy on ye!
That's so mean… I'm a girl, you know~
I'm Kenji Asuka, Midorenger. Nice to meet you…
I'm Peggy Matsuyama. I'm Momorenger.

You're the TDF's support organization, the UCMA international crisis-management military alliance, aren't you? I was sure of it after watching that fight.

Our international defense organization EAGLE will soon be working with you through the TDF as well…

Let's fight together to defeat the Black Cross Army and the other organizations!!
And so… the secret of the Gorenger base was protected. But the Black Cross Army's ambitions know no bounds.
At a later date, a joint front with the TDF was formally announced in the name of Commander Gonpachi Edogawa.
Unite the five powers into one and protect the world, Gorengeeer!
Defeat the Locomotive Monster!

uncertain: U03537: 大ちゃん rendered 'Daita' (the Smug Man is Shinmei in disguise, addressing Daita).
U03545: a choice menu stored as narration; rendered as two quoted options.
U03594-U03596: Kirenger's riddle puns on ランプ/トランプ (lamp/playing cards, which you would not want to set on fire); adapted to an English bulb/flower-bulb pun.
U03599/U03602: Daita's Kyushu dialect rendered with light folksy speech.
U03606: UCMA国際危機管理軍事連合 rendered 'the UCMA international crisis-management military alliance' (acronym kept per glossary).
